papers.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
papers.abstract: Benchmark of 80 indoor scenes where VLM agents explore and estimate 3D object locations. The top model reaches only about 42% mean overlap, showing a gap between coarse layouts and precise maps.

papers.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
papers.abstract: Tests 450 RAG configurations with the open-source LASAGNA framework. Techniques that help alone often fail to combine well, and the best setup can change as the corpus grows.

papers.title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
papers.abstract: Benchmark where LLMs build stock-scoring strategies from 2022-2023 A-share data, then get judged on a sealed 2024 period. No evaluated model beat the equal-weight market that year.

papers.title: CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Feedforward 3D scene reconstruction that allocates Gaussians by image content, using dense primitives on complex regions and fewer on flat ones. Sparsity can be tuned at inference without retraining.

papers.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
papers.abstract: SERA pairs an editable VLM planning harness with a fixed VLA executor, revising its plans from execution feedback. It reaches 51.38% success on RoboMME versus 44.38% without self-evolution.

papers.title: WorldStream: Streaming Interactive 3D Worlds with Hierarchical Planning and Persistent State
papers.abstract: Open-ended 3D world model that extends terrain as the user moves, responds to language commands, and keeps edits persistent. It uses hierarchical planning and streamed compilation to manage cost.

papers.title: StyleStream 2.0: Fast and Controllable Streaming Voice Style Conversion
papers.abstract: Streaming voice conversion with about 520 ms latency on a consumer GPU, roughly twice as fast as the prior version. Adds text-driven voice design and attribute-specific voice editing.

papers.title: From RL Papers to Framework Code: Inclusion and Review in Seven Open-Source Training Frameworks
papers.abstract: Traces seven open-source RL training frameworks and finds only 37 of 1,598 general-method papers were adopted by at least one. Most proposed methods get no public discussion.

papers.title: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents: Causal Evidence for Latent Communication
papers.abstract: Shows diffusion language model agents can pass compact continuous messages that receivers causally use. A single late transfer outperformed four recurrent exchanges on QASC.

papers.title: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
papers.abstract: Learns continuous latent tokens that model a partner's beliefs and likely actions, improving LLM agent coordination in games and negotiation. Gains transfer to unseen partner models, including GPT-5.4.

cc_updates.body:
What's changed

* Bug fixes and reliability improvements

What's changed

* Added `/claude-api api-version` to move Claude API code to API version `2026-10-21`
* Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back
* Fixed requests failing with a model-not-found error when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` is set and the model is an alias with the `[1m]` suffix, such as `opus[1m]`
* Fixed the `prompt-caching-scope` beta header being sent behind custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways and on Foundry, where it has no effect

What's changed

* Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables
* Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools
